sonnet.problem: The card cites Genesis 12:11-13, but it only tells verses 12 and 13: Abram's worked-out disaster and the ask to say she's something else. Verse 11 was already told on card 3 and isn't used here, so the citation is wider than the card.
sonnet.rule: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
